title: Final Portal Ambush Cheese
instructions:
By walking up to the portal directly, all Melee enemies will follow you and die at its threshold.

You can get ranged enemies and Corrupted Minibosses like the Evoker to path up there by using a corner just a jump away at its lower right edge.
